claims: "Golden" from the animated film KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
"Golden" is the first K-pop song to win the Oscar.
"Golden" was performed by EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami.
The performers/voices for "Golden" are EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami (as HUNTR/X).
The songwriters of "Golden" are Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo, and Teddy Park.

According to AP News, the other nominees for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards were "I Lied to You" (Sinners), "Sweet Dreams of Joy" (Viva Verdi!), "Train Dreams" (Train Dreams), and "Dear Me" (Diane Warren: Relentless).
"Golden" won Best Song Written for Visual Media at the Grammys on February 1, 2026.
"Golden" won awards at the Golden Globes.
"Golden" won awards at the Critics Choice Awards.
The team's acceptance speech for "Golden" at the 98th Academy Awards was cut short.
The orchestra began playing to cut off the team's acceptance speech for "Golden" at the 98th Academy Awards.
